source_text: Girls citing FGC as most bothersome (16.8%) show lower PTSD rates (4.8%) and better functioning than those affected by other traumas (22.1%), indicating FGC's trauma may be overshadowed by broader adversities; physical complications like genital pain do not significantly correlate with PTSD attribution in this cohort. [13]
